taskVersion.name: ves-synthetic-b-item

parts.text:
Curve-type notation for vertical electrical sounding (VES): take the layer resistivities in depth order. For each group of three consecutive layers (layers 1-2-3, then 2-3-4, and so on), write one letter: A if r1 < r2 < r3; Q if r1 > r2 > r3; H if r1 > r2 < r3; K if r1 < r2 > r3. A curve with N layers gets N-2 letters, in depth order (for example, a 4-layer curve gets 2 letters, such as HA). If all the letters are the same, the curve may also be written as that single letter (AAA may be written A).

Station T-29, survey area T. Interpreted layer model:

Layer | Resistivity (ohm-m) | Thickness (m) | Depth to base (m)
----- | ------------------- | ------------- | -----------------
1 | 995.1 | 4.02 | 4.02
2 | 1300.6 | 35.56 | 39.58
3 | 381.3 | 12.04 | 51.62
4 | 1563.6 | 22.76 | 74.38
5 | 1611.9 | - | -

The survey interpretation on file classifies this station's curve as AAA-type.

Is this label correct for these layer values? Give a short answer, then end with one JSON line exactly like this:
{"label_correct": true or false, "curve_type": "<letters>"}

The provided resistivity values are:
1. 995.1 $\Omega\cdot\text{m}$
2. 1300.6 $\Omega\cdot\text{m}$
3. 381.3 $\Omega\cdot\text{m}$
4. 1563.6 $\Omega\cdot\text{m}$
5. 1611.9 $\Omega\cdot\text{m}$

To determine the curve-type notation, we examine groups of three consecutive layers:
- **Layers 1-2-3:** 995.1 < 1300.6 > 381.3. This follows the pattern $r_1 < r_2 > r_3$, which corresponds to the letter **K**.
- **Layers 2-3-4:** 1300.6 > 381.3 < 1563.6. This follows the pattern $r_2 > r_3 < r_4$, which corresponds to the letter **H**.
- **Layers 3-4-5:** 381.3 < 1563.6 < 1611.9. This follows the pattern $r_3 < r_4 < r_5$, which corresponds to the letter **A**.

The resulting notation is **KHA**. Therefore, the label AAA-type is incorrect.

{"label_correct": false, "curve_type": "KHA"}
